cases.statement: Three batch rows that very likely describe one Czech woman: Patient #7 of a Czech flow-cytometry screening study (32657043), entry #8 of a literature table that cites that study (36876541), and case 8 of a retinal series whose Czech cases 7-10 were published earlier (42366573). The pipeline kept three identities.

functional.statement: Patient cells and tissue (32657043): 44.3% of granulocytes and 52.7% of monocytes LAMP2-deficient by flow cytometry (threshold 5%), matching WBC XCI 46:54; mosaic LAMP2 expression on cardiac IHC; only wild-type allele mRNA/cDNA detected. No construct assay.

Sanger electrophoreograms compare the gDNA and mRNA/cDNA sequence profiles in all three patients. Only the wild-type allele mRNA/cDNA transcripts are detectable in all three patients.
A threshold of 5% of LAMP2def granulocytes (or monocytes) was set to calculate the sensitivity and specificity of the FC assay.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: One-base deletion predicted to cause a frameshift (p.(Leu140PhefsTer8) on NM_002294.3). 32657043 and 36876541 write p.Leu139Phefs*8; 42366573 writes p.(Leu140Phefs*8). The authors of 32657043 state that almost all reported LAMP2 variants putatively result in absent protein.

We recruited 11 cases with pathogenic variants in LAMP2 across five countries.
LAMP2 coding reference sequence (RefSeq) is NM\_002294.3. Described variants are considered causative for LAMP2-­associated retinopathy.

concerns: Same-person duplicate: DANON-ID0121 (32657043 #7), DANON-ID0472 (36876541 #8, cited to Gurka et al. = 32657043) and DANON-ID0320 (42366573 case 8, Czech, from a set of Czech cases previously published) agree on c.418del, DCM and transplant at 24, and are very likely one woman.
Residue numbering differs: p.Leu139Phefs*8 (32657043, 36876541) vs p.(Leu140Phefs*8) (42366573, NM_002294.3, and the batch). The panel should confirm the residue.

Contradictions between reports of this woman: age at onset 23 (32657043) vs symptom onset 28 with transplant at 24 (42366573 Table 2); 'only affected individual in the family' (32657043) vs family history 'Positive Germline' read from 42366573's garbled Table 1.
36876541 #8 is a review-table entry with no case description.

42366573 Table 1 is garbled in the text: rows are transposed and several cells hold two cases stacked (e.g. 'p.(Ile143Serfs*5) p.(Thr347Profs*4)', ages '14 12', 'Female Female', 'UK UK'). Per-case values here were read by column position and matched against the coding-variant row; the panel should verify them in the original PDF (stacked-cell reading, D-31).
notes_for_panel: Strong patient-cell evidence (mosaic LAMP2 deficiency in WBCs and heart, no mutant mRNA detected) for one woman reported three times.
